title: Why do we only have one channel?
summary: Root ask answered: channels were opt-in, and buddies-dev was the only channel at the time. After the owner's follow-up complaint asking to fix the lack of channels/projects/general, the Lead created #general, #buddy-repairs, #channels-feature and #releases, posted task links, and cancelled two stale superseded tracking tasks. Current task evidence shows #general default provisioning implemented in fix/workspace-general @ b99a894 and in review, with owner merge timing/backfill decision outstanding. The channel count question/action is closed; broader workspace setup is not all released. No dropped work found; proposal to rename mailing lists fully/archive/unify send was explicitly parked/cancelled under the existing rename task.
nextAction: Owner to approve merge timing for #general provisioning and choose how existing workspaces without #general are handled (current task recommends a Home affordance; no backfill is implemented). The Lead should ensure #general task reaches integrated/released status after approval. No follow-up needed for the original channel-count question.
evidence: Thread replies: post_ebe22367-1894-4494-a0b4-16b06e849729 (why only one), post_397c3ea4-47ab-45e5-9da7-942472a0ae28 (created four channels and task-linked posts)
Current channel read shows #buddies-dev exists; #general existence inferred from owner-accepted implementation plan and task evidence, not directly enumerated through channel list API in this review.
Task buddy_project_d157d274-80b7-472b-991c-eb4ca4192a9b is done: display-only Channels rename shipped; full rename, archive and unified send explicitly cancelled/no demonstrated need.

Tasks buddy_project_37f2780f-f766-452b-991c-eb4ca4192a9b and buddy_project_9864f34e-b435-43b1-80b1-07cc51645fbe are cancelled as superseded; evidence preserved and successors identified. Task task_01a10acc-88dd-712c-92b4-7f8a967cabc3: #general provisioning branch fix/workspace-general @ b99a894dec88f5dac4a1dae654ba2880325a10e6; worker-reported crate/server/typecheck and screenshot evidence; not merged/pushed/restarted; status review.
limitations: The #general task includes owner approval needed for merge timing because merging reloads the live backend; this review did not alter tasks or request approval.
The broader question of existing workspaces lacking #general remains undecided; implementation deliberately has no backfill.
No direct current channel enumeration tool was available; #general current state is evidenced by its task/branch report, not a live channel list.
